belugawales3: Day 9: Albin Belugawales reached S-C3 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

The Hegemony sentry, Casimir Schradog, shouted once. Albin Belugawales silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@schradog2) Albin Belugawales was on watch at S-C3 when the night raid hit. The men found Albin Belugawales at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Casimir Schradog of the Hegemony (@schradog2).
Gustav Belugawales joined S-C3 under the shadow of Albin Belugawales's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Gustav Belugawales was hit in the hip at S-C3. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Lucien Tzukitolotl of the Hegemony (@tzukitolotl). Gustav Belugawales was killed at S-C3 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Lucien Tzukitolotl of the Hegemony (@tzukitolotl).

Anselm "Tin" Belugawales took the same post at S-C3 where Gustav Belugawales stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Anselm "Tin" Belugawales is number 748. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. After the loss of Grey Mill, Anselm "Tin" Belugawales helped stack spare sandbags at S-C3. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Anselm "Tin" Belugawales and Isidor Jeffwiratama have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out. Mail came up the line with a letter for Anselm "Tin" Belugawales. Anselm "Tin" Belugawales read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Anselm "Tin" Belugawales was carrying water up to S-C3 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Anselm "Tin" Belugawales did not. Shot by Ulrich Tym of the Hegemony (@ty_m1015). Anselm "Tin" Belugawales was hit at S-C3 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Ulrich Tym of the Hegemony (@ty_m1015).
The papers connected Ulrich "Whistle" Belugawales to Anselm "Tin" Belugawales. The men took longer to learn Ulrich "Whistle" Belugawales's own habits, but they made the effort.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Ulrich "Whistle" Belugawales received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich "Whistle" Belugawales. Ulrich "Whistle" Belugawales read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Ulrich "Whistle" Belugawales aimed just below it. Jakub Mccooper was grazed. Now serving as a sapper, Ulrich "Whistle" Belugawales discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

A pump handle snapped off in Ulrich "Whistle" Belugawales's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles. Ulrich "Whistle" Belugawales got a letter with a recipe in it. Nobody in the trench had any of the things it needed.
billy.forestier: The old hands of T-F20 have been here since Day 1. Edmund Forestier has been here since Day 10. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Edmund Forestier lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Edmund Forestier wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
The mud froze hard overnight. For one morning Edmund Forestier could walk on top of it, like a man walking on water.
Edmund Forestier and Casimir Lordfulgrim carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Edmund Forestier said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
Edmund Forestier (Hegemony) watched Yann "Ash" Tons (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at Blackwater Canal, and held fire until both were gone.
A parcel from home held a comb. Edmund Forestier has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
cal.ricky07: Albin Ricky arrived on Day 16 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
dennyw00d: Ulrich Dennyw reached P-F20 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Ulrich Dennyw during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Ulrich Dennyw pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Dennyw. Ulrich Dennyw read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The parcel for Ulrich Dennyw contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Dennyw. Ulrich Dennyw read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ulrich Dennyw went out with the wiring party at P-F20. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Dennyw. Ulrich Dennyw read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Ulrich Dennyw's ear at P-F20 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Matthias Fordlowe of the Concord (@fordlowe). Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Dennyw. Ulrich Dennyw read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ulrich Dennyw returned to P-F20 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. A letter reached Ulrich Dennyw in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.
dunkmyanactual: Otto Dunkmyanactu arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

An enemy patrol scattered in front of S-R4. Otto Dunkmyanactu fired at the last man to run. Karel Lynallwarrio was grazed. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-R4 and grazed Otto Dunkmyanactu's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Emil Majormalprac of the Concord (@majormalpractice_626). News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Otto Dunkmyanactu during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better. A letter from home reached Otto Dunkmyanactu before dusk. Otto Dunkmyanactu read it twice and slept a little easier.

The medics cleaned Otto Dunkmyanactu's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-R4. A letter from home reached Otto Dunkmyanactu before dusk. Otto Dunkmyanactu read it twice and slept a little easier. The machine gunners took Otto Dunkmyanactu in on a busy morning in S-R4. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second. Grey Mill has been won. Otto Dunkmyanactu listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Otto Dunkmyanactu gave Ivo Enriquez the last match in the trench. Ivo used it to light a candle so that Otto could finish a letter. A letter from home reached Otto Dunkmyanactu before dusk. Otto Dunkmyanactu read it twice and slept a little easier.

Otto Dunkmyanactu was hit through the chest at S-R4. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple of the Concord (@kamdensipple). Otto Dunkmyanactu was killed at S-R4 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple of the Concord (@kamdensipple).
The House of Dunkmyanactu sent Casimir Dunkmyanactu after Otto Dunkmyanactu. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

At Hill 304, Quentin "Hollow" Diboo and Casimir Dunkmyanactu exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent. A letter from home reached Casimir Dunkmyanactu before dusk. Casimir Dunkmyanactu read it twice and slept a little easier.
Casimir Dunkmyanactu had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Edmund "Ash" Yer was grazed.
The machine gun jammed at the worst moment. Casimir Dunkmyanactu cleared it with a bent nail and words the chaplain pretended not to hear.
edheadl: Lucien Edheadl came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Lucien Edheadl did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. A letter from home reached Lucien Edheadl before dusk. Lucien Edheadl read it twice and slept a little easier. Lucien Edheadl bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'

Lucien Edheadl was promoted to Lance Corporal. The first request addressed to the new rank concerned a blocked drain. The mail bag came up with the soup. There was a letter for Lucien Edheadl, and the soup went cold while Lucien Edheadl read it. Victory at Grey Mill. Lucien Edheadl let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Lucien Edheadl failed to return from the wire. A search found tracks leading into churned ground and nothing certain beyond it. A letter for Lucien Edheadl came up the line that evening. The corporal did not send it back. He put it in his own pocket and said he would hand it over himself.

No word on Lucien Edheadl. A runner went to ask in the next sector and came back with nothing. At dusk Lucien Edheadl walked back into R-R5, covered in mud, and asked for a place on the wiring party. The sergeant crossed the name off the missing list. The corporal kept his word: the letter he had carried for two days went straight into Lucien Edheadl's muddy hands.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Lucien Edheadl tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-R5 is up. A letter reached Lucien Edheadl in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.

Lucien Edheadl had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any. Lucien Edheadl kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.

The Concord sentry, Jakub "Button" Gavinlordofp, shouted once. Lucien Edheadl silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@gavinlordofpugs) Lucien Edheadl came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. A thin letter reached Lucien Edheadl. Only five lines long, and Lucien Edheadl knew every one of them by heart before supper.
jacob.hendryx: They issued Emil Hendryx a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a stub of a pencil in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F8 with the rations. Emil Hendryx ate while listening to the revised orders.

Emil Hendryx took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Emil Hendryx looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Emil Hendryx could not stop listening to it.
Emil Hendryx opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Emil Hendryx accepted promotion to Lance Corporal. Later, he practised giving the morning orders quietly enough not to wake the dugout.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Emil Hendryx lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
Emil Hendryx checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.
jirka_knoppu: Lucien Knoppu walked into Q-S9 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached Q-S9 with the rations. Lucien Knoppu ate while listening to the revised orders.

Officers came to inspect Q-S9. Lucien Knoppu polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is. After the loss of Grey Mill, Lucien Knoppu helped stack spare sandbags at Q-S9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Lucien Knoppu polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.
Lucien Knoppu (Concord) and Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus (Hegemony) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at Grey Mill on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home.

Lucien Knoppu went out with the wiring party at Q-S9. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. Mail came up the line with a letter for Lucien Knoppu. Lucien Knoppu read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Casimir Lilsaint of the Hegemony shouted a joke across the wire at Grey Mill. Lucien Knoppu of the Concord laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.

Across the wire at the Sunken Road, Henrik "Saint" Rlhaight of the Hegemony held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Lucien Knoppu of the Concord held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.' Lucien Knoppu asked to leave the runners and serve as a rifleman. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.
kadentav1: Pavel "Mole" Kadentav came up on Day 12 carrying news from Lindenbruck. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Pavel "Mole" Kadentav (Concord) shouted a challenge across to Viktor Pauar (Hegemony) at Lantern Hill. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Pavel "Mole" Kadentav has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
Pavel "Mole" Kadentav fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Karel Christ, badly wounded.
On sentry duty Pavel "Mole" Kadentav watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
kedrik_ryan: Walter "Spark" Ryan signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at N-F7 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Clement "Hollow" Steelhouses stood up to sing louder, and Walter "Spark" Ryan fired. Clement "Hollow" Steelhouses was grazed. The singing stopped.
Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Walter "Spark" Ryan only heard boots on the duckboards at N-F7, then nothing but pain. Raider: Nils Mcwillzz of the Concord (@mcwillzz).
lbz.z1p: At the depot, Bastian Lbz had practised answering to his name. At N-F9, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate. After the loss of Grey Mill, Bastian Lbz helped stack spare sandbags at N-F9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Bastian Lbz and Ivo Warrior carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Bastian Lbz and Dorian "Ash" Juanito have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
Bastian Lbz spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
Bastian Lbz reads Albin Gabor's letters from home out loud, because Albin never learned to read. Bastian leaves out the sad parts. Albin knows.

The Hegemony raiders came over at N-F9 in the middle of the night. Bastian Lbz met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Quentin "Shadow" Nalabrad of the Hegemony (@nalabrad).
The House of Lbz sent Konrad Lbz after Bastian Lbz. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
lord_banks_eaton: The new rifleman is Rafael Eaton, once a railway porter from Oakmere. The corporal asked if a railway porter was any use in a trench. Rafael Eaton said he would find out.
The last of the jam was shared by adding hot water and calling it a drink. Rafael Eaton approved the method.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Rafael Eaton waited for that to change. When it did, Arno Posting was badly wounded.

Rafael Eaton checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone. Now serving as a signaller, Rafael Eaton discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.
monty.mace: Cyril Mace arrived on Day 10 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Cyril Mace as a story about a general. The ending was the same. A letter from home found Cyril Mace before the night shift. Cyril Mace folded it small and kept it close. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Cyril Mace wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp reads Cyril Mace's letters from home out loud, because Cyril never learned to read. Crow leaves out the sad parts. Cyril knows. A letter from home found Cyril Mace before the night shift. Cyril Mace folded it small and kept it close.
Cyril Mace thought about a girl from the dance hall, maybe on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.

Cyril Mace spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at P-F24 is closed now. A letter from home found Cyril Mace before the night shift. Cyril Mace folded it small and kept it close.
Severin Ettnyttrikar of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Cyril Mace kept the tin.

In the dark of the Hegemony trench Cyril Mace hit Edmund "Crow" Ddebb with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@d00d1eb0b) Night raid. Cyril Mace crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Cyril Mace. A letter came for Cyril Mace with a ribbon tied around it. Cyril Mace kept the ribbon in a tunic pocket.
mr._tax_evader: Cyril "Spark" Evader walked into T-F22 on Day 10 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Cyril "Spark" Evader put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise. Victory at Grey Mill. Cyril "Spark" Evader let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Cyril "Spark" Evader reached up to fix a sandbag at T-F22 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Tobias Realvirtuali of the Concord (@realvirtuality).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Cyril "Spark" Evader is whole again, or near enough for the line.
A replacement turned out to be from Coldwater too. Cyril "Spark" Evader and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Cyril "Spark" Evader shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Karel Slow, was grazed.

The Concord raiders came over at T-F22 in the middle of the night. Cyril "Spark" Evader met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Silas "Whistle" Theophane of the Concord (@theophane_br).
Severin Evader came to the front because his older brother Cyril "Spark" Evader never came home. He carries a key to a house that is no longer there.
rebel_wulf: On the way to V-F21, Valentin "Bones" Wulf tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Valentin "Bones" Wulf saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. There was a letter for Valentin "Bones" Wulf and a little tobacco folded inside. The tobacco went round the squad. The letter did not.
rico__san: Matthias San arrived with the Day 11 draft, carrying a child's drawing of a horse and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it. Victory at Grey Mill. Matthias San let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Teodor Timmy (Concord) watched Matthias San (Hegemony) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Chalk Pits, and held fire until both were gone.
Fog so thick that Matthias San could not see the end of his own rifle. Somewhere out there, someone was whistling.
Nils Axebozo and Matthias San sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
Rain blew in under the dugout door. Matthias San moved his boots out of the wet, then realized they were already inside.
A round went through the rim of Matthias San's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Ivo Ursarte of the Concord (@not_ursarte).
sem0235: Albin Sem came up with a draft of replacements on Day 5. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Albin Sem shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Sem. Albin Sem read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Victory at Hill 304. Albin Sem let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Albin Sem began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Sem. Albin Sem read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Orders came through: Albin Sem is a rifleman now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts.

Albin Sem sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Sem. Albin Sem read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Felix Jakub and Albin Sem split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Sem. Albin Sem read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gustav Karter taught Albin Sem three words in the language of home. Albin uses all three at the wrong moment, every day. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Sem. Albin Sem read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

In the dark of the Concord trench Albin Sem hit Yann Vee with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@ask._.vee) The Concord sentry, Tobias Noirangelfan, shouted once. Albin Sem silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@noirangelfang) Albin Sem came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Albin Sem ate a whole bowl of soup today. The surgeon says that is better than any medicine. Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Albin Sem shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Sem. Albin Sem read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A medic stopped by Albin Sem's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Albin Sem had gone back to S-S9. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Albin Sem answered to number 346. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Albin Sem shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
The parcel for Albin Sem contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.

Albin Sem carried duckboards up from the rear all night. His shoulders are a map of splinters. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Sem. Albin Sem read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Orders assigned Albin Sem to work as a sniper. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

A shell hit the latrine at S-S9. Nobody was hurt. Albin Sem says it was the best day of the war. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Sem. Albin Sem read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A stretcher party needed the passage. Albin Sem backed into a recess with an ammunition box and stayed there until the last bearer passed.

Night raid. Albin Sem crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Albin Sem. Albin Sem read the letter out loud to the squad, skipping the private parts. The men asked to hear it again.
tezands: In Wyvern Cross, Isidor "Ash" Tezands was a shepherd. In S-S8, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a shepherd again. Isidor "Ash" Tezands transferred to the snipers. The men in S-S8 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.
Walter Small of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Isidor "Ash" Tezands kept the tin.
Isidor "Ash" Tezands wrote a letter for Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas's mother, because Mole could not find the words. Mole signed it.
After the shelling at S-S8, nobody could account for Isidor "Ash" Tezands. His kit remains beside the bunk.
The squad at S-S8 still leaves a gap on the fire step where Isidor "Ash" Tezands used to stand.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Isidor "Ash" Tezands wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Someone at S-S8 saved Isidor "Ash" Tezands's share of the rations. Nobody said why. Isidor "Ash" Tezands got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 387. The men who came later will ask about it. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Isidor "Ash" Tezands wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
The missing report was still on the desk when Isidor "Ash" Tezands walked in. The clerk crossed it out hard enough to tear the paper.
Isidor "Ash" Tezands got a letter from Clara. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
Isidor "Ash" Tezands wrote back to Clara and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.
Isidor "Ash" Tezands and Valentin Betts share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
Shell splinters hit Isidor "Ash" Tezands in the back and legs at S-S8. The bearers carried him face down on the stretcher.
thicc_kochek: The quartermaster asked Bram Kochek to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Bram Kochek helped stack spare sandbags at S-R8. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Bram Kochek fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at S-R8. Before dawn Florian Team walked into it, grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Bram Kochek is number 825 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Bram Kochek read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Bram Kochek agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
Bram Kochek fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Gustav "Tin" Jul was badly wounded trying to cross it.
Bram Kochek and Matthias "Shadow" Deakins sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
The artist tried again while Bram Kochek read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.

Bram Kochek jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Leopold Matteozrybak. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@matteozrybak) Bram Kochek went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. A direct hit on the trench at S-R8. Bram Kochek was the only one they could still help, and only just. Bram Kochek held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
Another member of the House of Kochek reached the line: Isidor Kochek. He asked where Bram Kochek had slept, then chose a different corner.
tongantui: The new signaller gave his name as Ivo Tongantui. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week. Orders came through: Ivo Tongantui is a machine gunner now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a photograph gone soft at the edges.
New laces made Ivo Tongantui's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up. A letter from home found Ivo Tongantui before the night shift. Ivo Tongantui folded it small and kept it close.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Ivo Tongantui fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
tonyhuang000: Florian Tonyhuang was a ferryman in Coldwater until the posters went up. He came to S-F6 with a tin of tobacco, and within a day the whole bay knew that he can fall asleep anywhere, instantly.
Verdel Ridge is lost. Florian Tonyhuang heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Florian Tonyhuang began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.

The barrage caught Florian Tonyhuang in the open at S-F6. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Florian Tonyhuang was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. Florian Tonyhuang slipped away in the night. The orderly who sat with him says he was not afraid.
Zeno Tonyhuang came to the front because his father Florian Tonyhuang never came home. He carries a tin of tobacco.

A rat stole Zeno Tonyhuang's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Zeno Tonyhuang during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Zeno Tonyhuang offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
Dawn watch. Zeno Tonyhuang put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar, grazed.
A parcel came for Zeno Tonyhuang that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: several carefully wrapped biscuits. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.

Zeno Tonyhuang felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F6. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar of the Concord (@corporalstars).

The wound on Zeno Tonyhuang's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Zeno Tonyhuang helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Zeno Tonyhuang shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Cyril Creason, was grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Zeno Tonyhuang is number 165 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Zeno Tonyhuang watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Zeno Tonyhuang fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Matthias Manningwam was badly wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.
Zeno Tonyhuang was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Otto Tephydraws was gravely wounded.
The parcel's address was smudged. Zeno Tonyhuang took it to the clerk, who found two possible units and no reason to hurry.
Zeno Tonyhuang of the Hegemony and Walter "Smokes" Mander of the Concord have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at Sorrow Copse. It is getting crowded.
Zeno Tonyhuang did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Zeno Tonyhuang fired back. Pavel Singh was badly wounded.
